intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“赛车手和速度纪录 -> Bonneville Salt Flats -> Bluebird 专门制造 -> 车长和马力 -> 轮胎爆裂与控制困难 -> 平均速度结果 -> 错误被更正 -> 父子传承”的故事线跟读。重点读清 Sir Malcolm Campbell, miles per hour, Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah, Bluebird, specially built, horsepower, tyre burst, average speed, a mistake had been made 和 following in his father's footsteps。

sentences.text: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：伟大的赛车手 Sir Malcolm Campbell 是第一个以超过每小时 300 英里速度驾驶的人。读清 proper name、racing driver 和 miles per hour，first man to drive 是突破点。

sentences.text: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他于 1935 年 9 月在 Utah 的 Bonneville Salt Flats 创造了新的世界纪录。地点名分块读，set up a new world record 要读成一个完整表达。

sentences.text: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Bluebird，也就是他驾驶的那辆车，是专门为他制造的。Bluebird 后稍停，the car he was driving 是插入说明，had been specially built 是过去完成被动。

sentences.text: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这辆车长超过 30 英尺，并有 2,500 马力发动机。数字读慢一点，in length 表示长度，horsepower 第一部分重读。

sentences.text: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：虽然 Campbell 达到超过每小时 304 英里的速度，但由于第一次行驶中轮胎爆裂，他很难控制汽车。Although 后先让步，主句落在 had great difficulty in controlling，tyre burst 是风险原因。

sentences.text: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：挑战结束后，Campbell 失望地得知他的平均速度是每小时 299 英里。was disappointed to learn 连读成“失望地得知”，average speed 是纪录判断的核心。

sentences.text: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：然而几天后，有人告诉他出了一个错误。However 后轻停，he was told 和 a mistake had been made 都是被动表达，读出结果被更正的转折感。

sentences.text: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：许多年后，Malcolm 爵士的儿子 Donald 追随父亲的脚步，也创造了世界纪录。Following in his father's footsteps 是传承表达，Donald 前后有逗号，set up a world record 呼应前文。
